Hand-collected from apartmenthomeliving.com under a fixed selection rule. Upload your own CSV below to replace it.

How this data was collected
Source
Listing pages on apartmenthomeliving.com, copied by hand.
Cities
Atlanta, Austin, Phoenix, Charlotte, Denver, Seattle, Chicago, Boston, San Diego and Los Angeles, covering all four market segments.
Selection rule
Fixed before scoring. In each city, the first five non-sponsored properties in the site's default order with an address inside the city. From each property, the smallest one-bedroom and smallest two-bedroom floor plan with a listed price. Penthouse, furnished and short-term plans were excluded. Gaps were filled from the next property in the same city.
Fields
Asking rent is the floor plan's advertised starting price. Size, bedrooms and bathrooms are as listed. Each of the 27 amenities is 1 if the page's amenity list names it and 0 otherwise. county_fips comes from the property's street address.
Caveat
The site orders properties itself, so the sample leans toward large, newer buildings. It shows how the tool works; it is not a representative estimate of the 2026 market.

Score your own listings: drop a CSV here or choose a file. It replaces the demo results. Required columns: listing_id, city, state, county_fips, square_feet, bedrooms, bathrooms, asking_rent, plus the 27 amenity columns (1 = listed, 0 or blank = not listed).
